author: KiroV2
body:
So today I was kicked for a simple mistake i did on destroying the monument. But however I was not warned before actually being punished. So SnowSX3 and i got to the monument. I was at low hearts and i needed to eat a golden apple. I was right clicking fast and scrolling down to my golden apple. I accidentally placed a glass block in front of the monument and I was only trying to eat a golden apple because I was at low hearts. I was also under pressure because other players were coming to kill us. So after the game ended I was kicked by the moderator know as SnowSX3. But yet i was not warned. And after i joined back into the same game. I tried to explain but he denied it and after a while he decided to explain. He ended up saying that the kick was a warning and to not do it ever again. I was shocked on how he said that a kick is a warning? I have evidence that the player Aex was half a witness. He could explain a little on what happened as well. Thank you and have a nice day.


Just to add. Why would I end up griefing at the monument if i risked my life just to get there and help? That does not make any sense. I was trying to comply with the rest of the player at the monument. :)

title: I Have been Punished Before Being Warned

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
Firstly, sorry for the inconvenience,

I was in that game too and as far as I know a monument block has always been a kick, as it is considered team trolling. You could have, not saying you did, but could have blocked others to get the monument credits for yourself. Also snow did apologize for kicking you, however there is no evidence of whether what you did was actually intentional or accidental. Therefore what Snow did was the best option. Anyways, I'm still a Jr.Mod and I can't actually change anything, but I hope I cleared some confusion up for you. :)

- Pav

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I was in the middle of breaking the monument when you came over and placed a block over the obsidian that I was mining.

This is seen as Team Griefing and normally results in a kick.
I never told you that "a Kick was a warning" this may have been a misunderstanding.

Warns and Kicks aren't normally appealable and I do feel like this was a justified infraction.
